messages:
docs-maya: Quick flagging: API ref for POST /v1/deployments/create has an example request with `model: "stable-xl"` but runtime expects `model_id`. Also response examples show `deployment_id` vs `id` inconsistency. Can we align?
eng-ram: yep saw that during the last patch. Server field is `model_id` now. I can confirm with a curl.
eng-ram: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model_id":"stable-xl"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/deployments/create
ci-bot: unit-tests: deployments#create request schema expects `model_id` (pass)
sdk-lee: our snippet generator pulled former examples and uses `deployment_id`. I'll update the snippet generator template after docs change so SDK examples match.
docs-maya: plan: open docs PR to change request example -> `model_id`, update response example to `id`, and add a brief migration note: "Old examples used `deployment_id` and `model`; current API uses `id` and `model_id`." Will also add a short callout for SDK maintainers.
pm-zoe: please add a changelog link and tag customers on Dedicated who might rely on the old field.
docs-maya: done, PR #4321 created. tagging @eng-ram @sdk-lee for review.
eng-ram: reviewing now, quick approve once CI green.
sdk-lee: will follow up with SDK PR after docs merge. Thanks.
